label: Balanced (9° / 30°)

solver.name: SU2
solver.build: official macOS release (x86_64, run under Rosetta on Apple Silicon), single process

geometry.description: Procedural rear wing, 2D section at z = 0.44 m: main plane 9°, flap 30°

reasons: residuals fell only 1.3 orders of magnitude (need 3)

field.encoding: int16 little-endian, base64, row-major from (x0, y0); value = int / scale; -32768 = no flow (inside a body)

limitations: Two-dimensional section of APEX F1's procedural rear wing at z = 0.44 m: not any team's wing, and not a measured shape.
Infinite-span flow: no endplates, tip vortices, beam wing or other 3D effects.
Wing in free air: no ground, car body, wheels or upstream wake.
Steady RANS with the Spalart-Allmaras model, fully turbulent, incompressible: separation and stall are predicted only as well as that model allows.
Not validated against experimental data for this shape.
